baseReconstruction.method: Remove the exact inherited directive comments, then format with the pinned TanStack Router Generator Prettier options; the result is byte-identical to the accepted base.
Delete each accepted disable/enable directive and its immediately preceding ASCII space from the decorated route, in descending offset order.

formatMigration.reason: The configured TanStack Router generator formats inline paired comments into a different physical layout than the previous manually formatted representation. Removing those comments and formatting reconstructs the accepted base exactly.
